purpose: Teach: 倉敷/ストライク/ワルツ/アイアン/鉄筋/蝋/シンデレラ/タンゴ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、倉敷の美術館に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: So I heard one of your customers visited the art museum in Kurashiki.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Slight lift of curiosity—noticing details Aoi has shared. Unhurried pace. The rhythm of someone genuinely interested in what matters to the people she cares about.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、野球のストライクのお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was telling you about baseball strikes, wasn't he?
lines.style: Brighter, more animated. A small smile in the voice. Connecting the dots with gentle playfulness—finding the details charming. Light touch on the observation, not probing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ワルツのレッスンに通われてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And one of your regulars goes to waltz lessons, I think you mentioned?
lines.style: Contemplative again. Soft, wondering tone. Cataloguing these small beautiful facts about the people Aoi encounters. Patient rhythm—savoring the moment of sharing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゴルフのアイアンクラブのお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer mentioned his golf iron clubs too, didn't he?
lines.style: Gentle confirmation. Unhurried, reflective. The tone of someone quietly delighted by the texture of ordinary lives. Soft landing on each phrase.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新店舗は鉄筋コンクリート造りにしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: For the new location, let's use reinforced concrete construction.
lines.style: Shift to quieter decisiveness. Clear, grounded tone—practical but not harsh. The voice of someone thinking ahead with care. Steady, measured delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店にキャンドル蝋の香りも入れたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And I'd like to bring in the scent of candles for the shop too.
lines.style: Gentler again. Wistful note—imagining the space with texture. Soft 'would like' energy. Building the future sensory by sensory. Warm but concrete.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、シンデレラの絵本が好きね、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of your customers' children really loves that Cinderella storybook.
lines.style: Tender, almost gentle-hearted. A slight smile. The delight of noticing what brings joy to a child. Unhurried, warm. Touch of affection in the observation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、タンゴのダンスを習われてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer takes tango lessons, doesn't he?
lines.style: Reflective, trailing slightly. A soft realization—one more detail Aoi carries from her days at the counter. Quiet tone, like finishing a thought they've been building together.
